subject.title: feat(plugins): add Computer Use provider contract

question: Should OpenClaw publish `api.registerComputerUseProvider({ id, label })` as a permanent Plugin SDK contract before the Wave 2 node-host consumer and its host-binding requirements are reviewed together?
rationale: The branch introduces a compatibility-sensitive external API, while the related open stack frames a broader host-discovery problem with unresolved metadata and launch-resolution boundaries. Code review cannot choose the permanent public contract safely without maintainer product and SDK direction.

options.title: Defer the runtime API
options.body: Keep or separately land only the manifest ownership path if needed, and add the public registration API with the Wave 2 consumer after its required resolution contract is approved.

options.title: Approve the minimal identity seam
options.body: Confirm that `{ id, label }` is intentionally permanent and that all launch, platform, permission, and transport resolution will remain outside the Plugin SDK API.

options.title: Adopt a broader host contract
options.body: Define the required host-binding metadata and resolution behavior first, then replace this staged API with the approved unified contract.

recommendation.title: Defer the runtime API
recommendation.body: Keep or separately land only the manifest ownership path if needed, and add the public registration API with the Wave 2 consumer after its required resolution contract is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked stacked contract work describes the adjacent node-host and macOS host-binding direction that determines whether this SDK boundary is durable.
